reason: The code itself is sound: every opcode is NMOS 6502, whole rows always start with Y = ry+7 where ry is a multiple of 8 (sky_geom: ytop = 8*(d2-d1), and the split rows' ry come from rl, which is a multiple of 8), so the 8-byte loop also exits with Y=&FF. Branch ranges fit: BPL -42, BMI +&42, BNE part +&2C. The self-modified JMP is computed from LO/HI(line8), so it moves with the code. Whole-row BPL cycles recounted: old 3*(B/4-1)+2, new 4*(B/8-1)+2 (the moved BPL at &3101 jumps from page &31 back to &30D9, so a taken branch costs 4), a saving of B/4+1 per whole row of B bytes, which is 17 for the average 64-byte row and about 25 a pass. Moving sky_img0 &317F->&3193 also changes which image blocks cross a page on the (d_ptr),Y reads: before, blocks 1 and 3 crossed; after, blocks 0 and 3 do. REFUTED on bytes: the +20 bytes do not fit the gameplay build. In build/strykers-gameplay.lst (built at HEAD, 01:23 today) sky_main's code is also in the main block (sky_draw &30E0, sky_img0 &31BC), and the free SKIP before unused_3400_original (&340D - GAME_DOWN in GAMEPLAY builds, game.6502:5329) starts at &3404: only 9 bytes free. 20 more bytes overrun it by 11, so ASSERT * <= unused_3400_original (game.6502:5333) fails and build.ps1 -Gameplay / make gameplay no longer assemble. The candidate's 'relies_on' (20 of 193 free bytes) counted only the plain build.
